intro.what: Minimal terminal-first open-source coding-agent CLI by Mario Zechner (Earendil)
intro.trust: No permission system or sandbox (YOLO mode) — .pi/ resources gated by project trust; codemode QuickJS sandbox

cards.what: Folders of instructions the agent discovers and reads only when needed
cards.format: SKILL.md dir; Agent Skills spec YAML frontmatter
cards.autoupdate: In pi packages: pi update --extensions; standalone dirs manual
cards.why: Same agentskills.io spec; un-gated drop into ~/.agents/skills

cards.what: Markdown prompt templates; the filename becomes the slash command
cards.autoupdate: In-package prompts update with pi update; standalone files manual
cards.why: Same md+frontmatter shape; filename is the command

cards.what: No built-in subagents; an official example extension adds markdown agents
cards.manage: install subagent example extension (symlink per README)
cards.autoupdate: Only via npm package pi update; core ships no subagent surface
cards.why: Example-level pattern, not core; promotion UNVERIFIED
emission: if emitted: copy md + install subagent ext

cards.what: No hooks files; extension code subscribes to agent lifecycle events
cards.format: TS/JS module: export default (pi) => pi.on(event, fn)
cards.autoupdate: Extension packages update via pi update --extensions; loose .ts manual
cards.why: Codegen: hook spec → TS extension calling pi.on()

cards.what: Bundles ship as npm packages: extensions, skills, prompts, themes
cards.format: package.json + pi-package keyword + pi key globs
cards.manage: pi install npm:|git:|path · pi list · pi remove · pi update
cards.autoupdate: Yes — pi update [--extensions] bumps installed packages + contents
cards.why: Must republish as npm; npm IS Pi's registry
emission: mirror: npm content-only, no lifecycle scripts

cards.what: External tool servers Pi connects to; config copies straight from Claude
cards.format: mcpServers JSON; stdio cmd/args/env | http url/headers/oauth
cards.autoupdate: Manual — pi mcp add or config edit; no server-entry update flow
cards.why: Claude/Cursor mcp.json entries copy as-is (official docs)
emission: alt: pi mcp add <name> --local -- cmd args

cards.what: Not available — Pi has no language-server integration as of 1.3.0
cards.autoupdate: No — nothing to update; no LSP surface exists in Pi 1.3.0
cards.why: Absent from pi.md; no native surface as of 1.3.0

cards.what: Richest API: extensions register tools, commands, providers, events in TS
cards.autoupdate: Yes when packaged — pi update --extensions; loose .ts drops manual
cards.why: Tool spec must codegen to a TS pi.registerTool module

cards.what: Terminal look via JSON themes; deeper TUI widgets via extension code
cards.format: strict theme JSON; name must equal filename
cards.autoupdate: Themes in a package update with pi update; manual drops stay put
cards.why: Theme schema Pi-only; core look + pi overlay fields

cards.what: No permission system or sandbox; a project trust gate decides what loads
cards.format: none — settings trust + exposure flags only
cards.autoupdate: No artifact to update — trust is a per-project prompt, not a file
cards.why: Nothing declarative to emit; record carries risk metadata
emission: codemode: sandbox for model-written JS only
